arms: U: gate_policy='ungated'. G: gate_policy='uhat', threshold=0.0 FROZEN, gate_uhat_source='shadow' (shadow-trained predictor, training data uncontaminated by gating; UsefulnessPredictor class unmodified, gate reads only). R: RetrievalGate('random', rate=r_s) where r_s = per-seed measured application rate of arm G on the same seed, gate_seed=derive_seed(s, 0, 'gate'). R runs after U and G.
background: EXP-FP-0007 (2026-10-07) promoted the shadow-gate uhat policy to INTEGRATED (H SUPPORTED: seed-mean dGU +0.3023, dGR +0.2532, 4 seeds, pomaze) with the CAUSAL label explicitly withheld pending replication breadth. This replication replays the identical instrument on 5 fresh seeds and adds two cross-env arms.
baseline: arm U = ungated retrieval-correction (correction applied whenever available; gate_policy='ungated').

conditions.pairing: identical primary seeds across arms within an env (paired)

frozen_gates.G0_instrument_validity: per env: G application rate strictly in (0, 1) on >=4/5 seeds; else that env's comparison is VOID (instrument failure, EXP-FP-0006 lesson).
frozen_gates.G1_fabrication_tripwire: CLEAN on all new/modified code, checked pre-run.
frozen_gates.G2_determinism: per env: recompute the first seed's G arm; unrounded mean_return must match at 1e-12 (rounded-vs-unrounded bug class fixed in EXP-FP-0007/FP-0008, fix already in the instrument: G_mean_return_raw carried unrounded); else that env VOID.
frozen_gates.G3_receipts: hash-chained lane receipt receipts/EXP-FP-0007R.json via experiments/harness.py write_receipt + verify_chain; pre-chain detail copy in prototypes/architecture-b/receipts/ (EXP-AB-K3C convention).

hypothesis: The shadow-ûhat gate advantage replicates on pomaze at the 5-seed bar and generalizes to at least one of two new environments (delayed_reward, changing_rule): per env, the gated arm (G) beats both the ungated arm (U) and the random-gated arm at the matched application rate (R) under the frozen win rule.
instrument: Reuse verbatim (additive only): run_arm / uhat_benefit_corr / gates imported from prototypes/architecture-b/exp_retrieval_gate_shadow.py; the original driver is NOT modified. Executor: prototypes/architecture-b/exp_retrieval_gate_shadow_repl.py. The shadow-correlate diagnostics (corr(uhat_shadow, benefit_shadow), clean-data arm-U ranking check) are retained as descriptive secondaries, identical instrumentation.
limitations: Closed-loop policy test: the gated trajectory diverges from the ungated trajectory once gating blocks; the shadow predictor's training data is uncontaminated by gating (counterfactual unconditional benefit) but lives on the gated trajectory. All returns may remain negative if the env is unsolved by all arms (as pomaze was in EXP-FP-0007: effect measured on an unsolved baseline). 5 seeds; no multiple-comparison correction preregistered (per-env verdicts reported honestly). CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED — this experiment measures closed-loop return deltas, nothing about conscious state; donor provenance n/a (no donor code).
null: On pomaze the win rule fails at the 5-seed bar, or it fires on pomaze but on neither new env — the EXP-FP-0007 result is seed-luck and/or pomaze-local.
preregistered_metric: EXACT: per env per seed, mean episode return over 15 closed-loop episodes; dGU = mean(G)-mean(U); dGR = mean(G)-mean(R). Per-env win rule: seed-mean dGU > 0 AND seed-mean dGR > 0, with >=4/5 seeds agreeing on the sign of BOTH comparisons. Promotion bar (fixed before the run): pomaze win rule FIRES at 5/5 seeds AND at least one of delayed_reward / changing_rule fires the same win rule.
promotion_rule: MATURITY.md retrieval row moves INTEGRATED -> CAUSAL only if the full preregistered bar is met (pomaze win fires at 5/5 AND >=1 new env fires). Partial results do NOT promote. On failure, record in research/negative_results.md as a bound on the EXP-FP-0007 claim.
seed_freshness: Checked 2026-10-07 before run: zero occurrences of each of 80001..80005 in experiments/EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md, receipts/*.json, and prototypes/architecture-b/receipts/*.json. (Note: 80101..80104 ARE primary seeds of a different registered experiment; the 80001..80005 block is untouched.)
